title: JP Seismic — Analytics
description: Exploration of the modelled seismic events themselves: where they happen, how strong, how deep, and how that moves over time. Reads the marts through the read-only role.

list.name: region
list.label: Region
list.query: select region_name from analytics_marts.dim_region union all select '(no region)' order by 1

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as events from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag

select max(f.magnitude) as max_magnitude from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag

panels.title: Potentially damaging
panels.description: Events the intermediate layer flags as potentially damaging — the definition lives in int_earthquakes_enriched, not in this panel.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) filter (where f.is_potentially_damaging) as damaging from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag

select count(*) filter (where f.has_tsunami_flag) as tsunami from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag

panels.title: Epicentres
panels.description: One point per event. Size follows magnitude, so a swarm of small events reads differently from a single strong one.

targets.rawSql: select f.latitude, f.longitude, f.magnitude, f.depth_km, f.place_raw from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag and f.latitude is not null

select f.magnitude_band, count(*) as events from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag group by 1 order by 2 desc

panels.title: Magnitude over time
panels.description: Max against median per JST day: a rising max with a flat median is one notable event, both rising is a genuinely more active period.

targets.rawSql: select f.occurred_on_jst::timestamptz as time, max(f.magnitude) as max_magnitude, (percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by f.magnitude))::numeric as median_magnitude from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Depth against magnitude
panels.description: Shallow strong events are the damaging ones — that is the corner of this plot worth watching.

targets.rawSql: select f.magnitude, f.depth_km from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag and f.depth_km is not null and f.magnitude is not null

select coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') as region, count(*) as events, round(max(f.magnitude), 1) as max_magnitude, round(avg(f.depth_km), 1) as avg_depth_km, count(*) filter (where f.is_potentially_damaging) as damaging from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 25

panels.title: Notable events
panels.description: Strongest first. usgs_url opens the official event page for anything worth checking by hand.

targets.rawSql: select f.occurred_at, f.place_raw as place, f.magnitude, f.depth_km, f.review_status, f.usgs_url from analytics_marts.fct_earthquakes f left join analytics_marts.dim_region r on f.region_key = r.region_key where $__timeFilter(f.occurred_at) and coalesce(r.region_name, '(no region)') in (${region:sqlstring}) and coalesce(f.magnitude, -1) >= $min_mag order by f.magnitude desc nulls last, f.occurred_at desc limit 50
